title: Summer electric push
metaDescription: Make every journey count with the Nissan Ariya. £2,500 charging credit with every new Ariya. Ends 31 August.
disclaimer: Figures quoted use a 130 kW DC fast charger. 35 minutes on the 63kWh battery, 40 minutes on the 87kWh battery. Charging time may vary.

layout.body: Nissan Ariya goes further than any other electric SUV, and it seats five, so every drive feels easier.

items.text: Rapid charging from 0 to 80% in as little as 35 minutes.
466 litres of boot space with the seats up.

layout.offerText: £2,500 charging credit with every new Ariya
layout.terms: Retail customers only. Summer offer ends 31 August.
